description: This Java class 'SafeObjectInputStream' extends ObjectInputStream to provide a secure deserialization mechanism by allowing only whitelisted classes and denying certain others, with configurable allowlist and denylist patterns.

classes.name: SafeObjectInputStream
classes.description: A secure subclass of ObjectInputStream that restricts deserialization to whitelisted classes based on configurable patterns.

methods.name: SafeObjectInputStream
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the stream with a configurable allowlist pattern based on properties.

methods.name: resolveClass
methods.description: Overrides the method to enforce denylist and allowlist rules during deserialization, throwing exceptions for unauthorized classes.
